title: 5 Truck Engines to Avoid Before 2027 (Even Toyota Made the List)
description:
Five truck engines with documented problems (recalls, federal investigations or court cases) to watch for in a used truck going into 2027, plus a bonus engine and a simple checklist. Every figure comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:59 1. Toyota 3.4L twin-turbo V6
5:26 2. GM 6.2L V8 (L87)
8:57 3. GM 5.3L V8 (L84)
11:53 4. Ford 6.7L Power Stroke (CP4 pump)
15:58 5. Ford 3.5L EcoBoost (2017-2020)
18:23 Bonus: Ram 3.0 EcoDiesel
20:10 Checklist before you buy in 2027

Sources:
- Motor1, Toyota Tundra engine recall expanded (May 2026): https://www.motor1.com/news/796643/toyota-tundra-engine-recall-debris-failures/
- AP via ABC7, Toyota replaces engines in 100K Tundras (2024): https://abc7ny.com/post/toyota-engine-recall-new-engines-100k-tundra-trucks-lexus-suv/15115365/
- GM Authority, GM 6.2L L87 post-recall failures and NHTSA EA26005: https://gmauthority.com/blog/2026/08/gm-6-2l-l87-engine-post-recall-failures-piling-up-nhtsa-investigation-shows/
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, GM lifter lawsuit stays intact (March 6, 2026): https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2026/03/federal-judge-denies-motion-to-split-gm-lifter-lawsuit-over-afm-dfm-keeping-silverado-and-sierra-v8-class-action-intact/
- Pickup Truck + SUV Talk, judge OKs Ford CP4 fuel pump class action (Oct 10, 2026): https://pickuptrucktalk.com/2026/10/judge-oks-class-action-lawsuit-against-ford-for-faulty-fuel-pumps/
- TFL Truck, Super Duty high-pressure fuel pump recall 24V-957: https://tfltruck.com/2025/01/ford-super-duty-high-pressure-fuel-pump-recall-news/
- Motor1, Ford 2026 recalls list (Super Duty fuel pump, March 2026): https://www.motor1.com/news/789583/ford-2026-recalls-list-models-affected/
- SlashGear, Ford 3.5L EcoBoost years to avoid: https://www.slashgear.com/1869052/ford-3-5-liter-ecoboost-engine-years-to-avoid
- TorqueNews, 5.0L vs 3.5L F-150 cam phaser repairs (April 16, 2026): https://www.torquenews.com/1084/50l-vs-35l-f-150-why-2026-buyer-should-choose-v8-avoid-4000-cam-phaser-repairs
- CarComplaints, Ram 1500 EcoDiesel EGR cooler settlement (2026): https://www.carcomplaints.com/news/2026/ram-1500-ecodiesel-lawsuit-settlement.shtml
